test_policy.notes: SAT/ACT scores are optional for international applicants; the checklist says they are not mandatory but help with scholarship decisions. The Common Data Set says scores are 'not required, but consider if submitted'. SAT EBRW 510 can be used to meet the English requirement.

requirements.notes: Applicants use Wright State's own admissions portal (the pages do not mention the Common App). The international landing page says international applicants can apply for free, while the checklist still mentions a $30 non-refundable fee, so no fee is shown. Minimum 2.5 cumulative high school GPA. Required: passport copy, official records from all schools, and an I-20 request form with a current bank statement in USD (the application-instructions page says proof of funds is not needed when applying). Admission decisions can take up to four weeks.

deadlines.label: International fall semester application deadline (fall 2027)
deadlines.notes: Page prints 'Fall Semester: June 30' with no year; fall 2027 assumed. Spring deadline is Nov 30 and summer is Mar 31. Apply early: scholarship funds are limited.

deadlines.label: International Ambassador Scholarship essay deadline
deadlines.notes: $10,000 per year; two first-year students selected for fall 2027. Requires admission as a first-year international applicant and a scholarship essay.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Exempt with an Intensive English Program completed at an accredited institution (or a program accepted by international admissions), graduation from an accredited U.S. high school, or graduation from a school in a country where English is the official language of higher education (list linked on the page). The page does not describe a Wright State ESL or conditional-admission pathway; a 2023 policy draft says the former LEAP program is no longer offered.

english.notes: Engineering and Computer Science: 71; English major: 79.
Page lists '3.5 (old scale: 61)'. Engineering and Computer Science programs need the 71 equivalent.
Minimum scaled score 162 with no subscore below 154.

cost.notes: Wright State's international estimate (two semesters, 12 credit hours): tuition $22,862, fees $1,037 (includes a $150 per semester international student fee), living expenses $11,000, books and health insurance $3,000; total $37,899. The page does not state the academic year

aid.notes: UCIE Undergraduate Merit Scholarship is automatic at admission: $6,000 (GPA 2.5-2.99), $8,000 (3.0-3.19) or $10,000 (3.2+) per year toward tuition, renewable with a 2.5 GPA and 24 credits; funds are limited. Vietnam and Southeast Asia Merit Scholarships are $12,000 per year (high school in the region required). International Ambassador Scholarship is $10,000 per year (essay, two awards). Only one institutional merit scholarship can be held. The Common Data Set reports no need-based aid for nonresidents.

sat.note: Wright State's international pages do not print an SAT code; look it up in the College Board code search.

act.note: Wright State's international pages do not print an ACT code; look it up at act.org.

toefl.note: The international pages do not print a TOEFL institution code.
